allocation_rule: core.roster.mixture_quotas: largest-remainder apportionment of 500 in proportion to the FULL devel scenario mixture, capped by each scenario's surviving candidate count and water-filled when a scenario's capacity is below its fair share. Not the DEV ladder's equal-per-scenario rule, which the ladder has already made infeasible on the remainder.
design: RESERVED rung-3 replication roster for SLURP (claim ladder rung 3). Unopened: no model, tool or scorer has seen these identities, the receipt lives under docs/receipts/rosters/ only, and no probe-sample view of it exists, so no flight can hydrate it before its own registration. Per-item fields are identity only: the draw stratifies on the gold scenario, but the scenario is published as an AGGREGATE allocation and withheld per item, exactly as the DEV ladder withholds it.
sample_selection_rule: one recording per utterance: exclude_groups keys every recording by its utterance, so at most one recording per utterance is ever selected and an excluded utterance takes all of its recordings with it
